info.title: Modern POS API baseline
info.description: Implementation contract for the Modern POS API. Authentication, settings, catalog, stock, recipes, sales, reports, printing, the Phase 2 table-order extensions, promotions, item modifiers, partial refunds and approval rules are implemented in apps/api. Read ARCHITECTURE.md for rules and authorization, and the additive purchasing, stock-count, waste and outlet-transfer lifecycle, the additive online-payment lifecycle with verified webhooks and reconciliation. Provider sandbox verification against a real QRIS account remains PENDING. Additive multi-outlet bookkeeping: outlet listing, outlet-scoped costing and expense categories, consolidated owner views, profit/margin availability gates and auditable CSV exports. Additive online ordering channels with signed inbound webhooks, deduplicated channel references, opt-in customer records, configurable retention and signed digital receipt artifacts. Third-party channel accounts and real email/SMS dispatch remain PENDING.
